newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian shares sink under wave of proft-taking.
newsitem.headline: Italian shares sink under wave of proft-taking.

text.p: 1625 GMT - Italian shares sank under a wave of profit-taking after six straight days of gains had propelled the index up by some 16 percent as domestic investors stepped in to reap profits and a weak Wall Street opening dampened sentiment.

* "This is the beginning of a correction and the futures market suggests it could have further to fall," said David Roberts, an equities specialist at Milan-based CIMO Sim. "The market went up too fast and this had to happen sooner or later."

* The Mibtel index was 1.67 percent down on the day at 11,878 with the Mib30 blue-chip index 2.06 percent lower 17,790. Compared with the day's high -- the Mib30 peaked at 18,735 earlier in the session -- the fall looked even sharper.
